_comment: CPV classification rules. Codes are matched on the 8-digit numeric part (before the check-digit dash). cyber_strict: 72800000 'Computer audit and testing services' and all children (prefix 728). cyber_broad_candidates: CPV families counted as cyber ONLY if a cyber keyword (config/cyber_keywords.json) matches the notice title: 72500000 'Computer-related services' (prefix 725), 72200000 'Software programming and consultancy' (prefix 722). ict_generic (placebo): CPV division 72 not classified cyber. 79417000 (safety consultancy = physical safety) is deliberately EXCLUDED everywhere - known misclassification trap identified in the thesis.
_match_on_comment: any_cpv = main + supplementary CPV codes are all considered; a notice is cyber_strict if ANY of its CPVs has a cyber_strict prefix. Alternative value 'main_cpv' restricts to the main code (first listed) - robustness option.
